snippet.title: Skullgirls Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Announcing Skullgirls, a new 2D fighting game from Autumn Games and Reverge Labs. Skullgirls is due in 2011 for PSN and XBLA.

The brainchild of fighting champ Mike "Mike Z" Zaimont and comic artist Alex "o_8" Ahad, Skullgirls pits fierce warriors against each other as they vie for the powerful and mysterious artifact known as the "Skull Heart."

Follow @Skullgirls on Twitter and Like us on Facebook for the latest updates on the game!

Official Site: http://www.skullgirls.com
Autumn Games: http://www.autumngames.com
Reverge Labs: http://www.revergelabs.com
